mapper.select: select patient_id from base_patient where concat(IFNULL(name,''),IFNULL(pinyin_name,''),IFNULL(mobile,'')) like concat(concat('%',#{combination}),'%')
select concat( format( ${countAge} / ${count} * 100, 2 ),'%') percentage

SELECT patient_id patientId, first_visit_date firstVisitDate, first_visit_doctors firstVisitDoctors, first_visit_outpatient firstVisitOutpatient, cumulative_consumption cumulativeConsumption, last_visit_date lastVisitDate, last_visit_doctors lastVisitDoctors, last_visit_outpatient lastVisitOutpatient, total_arrears totalArrears, number_of_visits numberOfVisits FROM base_patient WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT bp.id, bp.`name`, bp.gender, bp.mobile, bp.medicalNumber, bp.age, bp.faceUrl, btp.dentistId, btp.lastVisit, btp.lastVisitTime FROM ( SELECT bp.patient_id AS id, bp.`name`, bp.face_url AS faceUrl, bp.mobile, bp.medical_number AS medicalNumber, bp.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF( YEAR, bp.birthday, CURDATE()) AS age FROM base_patient bp WHERE concat( IFNULL( bp.`name`, '' ), IFNULL( bp.medical_number, '' ), IFNULL( bp.pinyin_name, '' ), IFNULL( bp.mobile, '' )) LIKE concat( concat( '%', #{query.patientKeyWord} ), '%' ) LIMIT 0, 10 ) bp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp1.patient_id, btp1.registered_dentist_id AS dentistId, btp1.employee_name AS lastVisit, btp1.treat_start_time AS lastVisitTime FROM ( SELECT max( btp.treatment_id ) AS treatmentId FROM base_treatment_process btp WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY btp.patient_id ) btp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT btp.treatment_id, btp.patient_id, btp.registered_dentist_id, btp.treat_start_time, be.employee_name FROM base_treatment_process btp LEFT JOIN base_employee be ON btp.registered_dentist_id = be.user_id WHERE btp.treat_end_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY btp.treatment_id ) btp1 ON btp.treatmentId = btp1.treatment_id ) btp ON bp.id = btp.patient_id

update base_patient p inner join ( select t.patient_id, min(t.treatment_id) as 'treatment_id' from base_treatment_process t group by t.patient_id ) t1 on p.patient_id = t1.patient_id inner join base_treatment_process t2 on t1.treatment_id = t2.treatment_id set p.first_visit_date = t2.treat_start_time , p.first_visit_doctors = t2.registered_dentist_id , p.first_visit_outpatient = t2.org_id where p.first_visit_outpatient is null

update base_patient p inner join ( select t.patient_id, max(t.treatment_id) as 'treatment_id' from base_treatment_process t group by t.patient_id ) t1 on p.patient_id = t1.patient_id inner join base_treatment_process t2 on t1.treatment_id = t2.treatment_id set p.last_visit_date = t2.treat_start_time , p.last_visit_doctors = t2.registered_dentist_id , p.last_visit_outpatient = t2.org_id where p.first_visit_outpatient is not null

update base_patient p inner join ( select t.patient_id, count(0) as 'qty' from base_treatment_process t where t.treatment_id is not null group by t.patient_id ) t on p.patient_id = t.patient_id set p.number_of_visits = t.qty

update base_patient p inner join ( select b.patient_id, sum(b.actual_amount) as 'total_amount', sum(b.debt_amount) as 'unpaid_amount' from base_bill b group by b.patient_id ) b on p.patient_id = b.patient_id set p.total_arrears = b.unpaid_amount , p.cumulative_consumption = b.total_amount
update base_patient bp set bp.visit_rate_old = bp.visit_rate , bp.vip_score_old = bp.vip_score , bp.vip_logo_old = bp.vip_logo

update base_patient bp inner join ( select p.patient_id , p.qty , (case when p.qty >= 3 then 100 when p.qty >= 2 then 80 else 60 end) * 0.6 + (case when p.amount >= 10000 then 100 when p.amount >= 5000 then 80 else 60 end) * 0.4 as 'score' , (case when p.member = '365' then '365' else '' end) as 'member' from ( select p.patient_id , ROUND(p.number_of_visits / (datediff(now(), p.first_visit_date) / 365)) as 'qty' , p.cumulative_consumption as 'amount' , p.member from ( SELECT p.patient_id , p.first_visit_date , p.number_of_visits , p.cumulative_consumption , (case when m.member_level_name is not null then '123' when c.coupon_name is not null then '365' end) as 'member' FROM base_patient p left join ( select m.patient_id, m.member_level_name from base_patient_member m where m.type = 0 and m.member_level_id < 4 ) m on p.patient_id = m.patient_id left join ( select c.patient_id, max(g.coupon_name) as 'coupon_name' from base_card c left join base_coupon g on c.coupon_id = g.coupon_id where c.status > 1 and g.coupon_name like '%365%' group by c.patient_id ) c on p.patient_id = c.patient_id ) p where p.member is not null ) p ) p on p.patient_id = bp.patient_id set bp.visit_rate = p.qty , bp.vip_score = p.score , bp.vip_logo = concat((case when p.score >= 90 then 'A' when p.score >= 80 then 'B' else 'C' end), p.member)
select p.vip_logo, count(*) as 'vip_qty' from base_patient p where p.vip_logo is not null and p.vip_logo != '' group by p.vip_logo
